purpose: Predeclare package hypotheses to test only after the active expanded architecture wave completes; do not trigger a competing workflow.
promotion_gate: Controlled paired sim-v2 confirmation remains authoritative; tournament prevalence is hypothesis generation only.

packages.hypothesis: A current-metagame copy-density package improves self-contained redundancy and opportunistic value without requiring the full heavy-copy architecture.
packages.evidence_note: cEDHStats six-month Kinnan card corpus updated 2026-08-02: Clever Impersonator 90.1% inclusion with +0.17 PPG association (90% interval +0.06 to +0.29); Mirage Mirror 89.6% with +0.12 association; current architecture screen remains the controlled gate.

packages.hypothesis: Artifact-weighted copy density may preserve Kinnan/rock synergy while adding flexible clone redundancy with fewer context-dependent enchantment slots.
packages.evidence_note: cEDHStats six-month Kinnan card corpus updated 2026-08-02: Phyrexian Metamorph 75.0% inclusion; observational effect is near-neutral, so simulation must determine whether the slot is useful in F10 specifically.

packages.hypothesis: Compact Druid/Effigy plus creature-tutor access may outperform broad clone density if the extra deterministic node is the actual source of architecture gains.
packages.evidence_note: Recent six-month tournament search contains 555 Kinnan lists with Devoted Druid, including multiple 2026 top finishes; this is prevalence/hypothesis evidence only.

packages.hypothesis: A high-card-quality flash/value plus creature-tutor package may improve resilience in tutor-heavy pods without adding a dedicated combo brick, while retaining compact access to deterministic creatures.
packages.evidence_note: cEDHStats six-month Kinnan card corpus updated 2026-08-02: Wan Shi Tong, Librarian 85.1% inclusion with +0.12 PPG association and 90% interval +0.01 to +0.22; Nature's Rhythm 91.5% with +0.24 and interval +0.12 to +0.36; Chord of Calling 89.6% with +0.16 and interval +0.04 to +0.27. Controlled paired simulation remains authoritative.

packages.hypothesis: A flash-oriented value package may improve card quality and interaction timing while keeping clone connectivity; test primarily in midrange and mixed adversarial pods after architecture screening.
packages.evidence_note: cEDHStats six-month Kinnan card corpus updated 2026-08-02: Valley Floodcaller 89.3%, Wan Shi Tong 85.1%, Clever Impersonator 90.1%. Observational correlations are hypothesis-only.

measurement.confirmation: 2,000-5,000+ paired games adaptively only while decision-relevant
measurement.primary_endpoint: strict protected deterministic attempt by end of Kinnan T4
report: conditional paired effect when package slot exposed
